missing_facts.description: Facts, numbers, names, instructions, caveats, or examples present in the original but absent from the rewrite

changed_claims.description: Claims whose meaning, strength, or modality differs between original and rewrite

added_claims.description: Claims, facts, or examples in the rewrite that the original does not contain

lost_links_or_references.description: Links, references, or quotations that were dropped or altered

modality_changes.description: Places where certainty or obligation changed, e.g. may/will, should/must

reasoning.description: One short paragraph explaining the verdict
